name: dumbbell hammer grip incline bench two arm row
description: A chest supported row on an incline bench with a neutral grip. It targets the mid back with little strain on your lower back.
instructions: Set a bench to a low incline and lie chest down on it with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang with palms facing each other.
Row both dumbbells toward your hips, leading with your elbows.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower slowly to full arm extension and repeat.
